title: First Light
objective: Soft-land a camera on the lunar surface and transmit surface images back to Earth.

title: Eyes on Mars
objective: Land a camera and spectrometer on Mars and transmit surface composition data.

bonusObjectives.text: Deploy a drill and find a subsurface sample

title: Listen to the Moon
objective: Deploy a seismometer on the lunar surface and downlink at least 24 hours of data.

bonusObjectives.text: Also find water ice with a drill

title: Titan Descent
objective: Survive atmospheric entry and land instruments on Titan's surface. Collect hydrocarbon samples.

title: Hot Neighbour
objective: Survive Venus entry and operate instruments for at least 30 minutes on the surface.

bonusObjectives.text: Transmit atmospheric composition data during descent

title: Tiny World
objective: Touch down gently on a low-gravity asteroid and collect carbon-rich surface samples.
